# Ready-to-paste prompt for Figma Make

Create a professional editable design for **STXIC Halo**, a Windows 10/11 floating workspace companion for monitoring AI coding agents and local PC performance. Use our brand identity, NOT an Apple notch replica.

Brand: STXIC is the parent brand, Halo is the product. Tagline: "Stay in flow. Halo keeps watch." Positioning: calm local-first workspace intelligence. Dark-first palette: Obsidian #0B0E12, Graphite #171C20, Soft White #F3F6F5, Halo Mint #B5F5CD, Warning Amber #F5C875, Coral #F28B8F, subtle blue #9DBFFD. Typography Segoe UI Variable, rounded geometry, 4 px spacing increments, clean restrained elevation, accessible contrasts. Editable ring-and-dot brand logo based on supplied SVGs.

Build organized Figma pages with components and auto-layout:
01 / Brand (mark, horizontal lockups, do/don't)
02 / Foundations (color variables, text styles, spacing, radii, shadows)
03 / Components (island shell, status dot, agent card, progress bar, attention card, metric tile, tab bar, toggle, tooltip)
04 / Compact island states (idle, working, attention, error, offline)
05 / Expanded desktop interface (Overview, Activity & Proof-of-Work, System Health, Settings)
06 / Onboarding & Integrations (Claude hook consent, Codex coming soon, privacy and disconnect)
07 / Marketing (landing page desktop/mobile, Microsoft Store screenshots, social card)
08 / Dev handoff (component names, state transitions, dimensions, interaction diagrams)

Important: Current v0.1 implements Claude lifecycle metadata and CPU/RAM plus a DEMO preview. Context, tokens, tests, Codex, GPU and FPS shown in illustrations MUST carry "Concept" or "Sample" labels. Focus on the signature future vision of Proof-of-Work and Agent Risk Radar; do not present them as shipped. Add explicit states for "Unavailable", "Stale", and "Not verified".

Avoid generic hero sections, neon cyberpunk gradients, Apple brand imitation, excessive glass blur, huge feature cards and fake performance figures without demo labels. Create a distinctive, credible Windows utility interface.
